versions.content: Asynchronous operation invocation Asynchronous invoca- tion is a bit more complex because it is necessary to specify how to respond to a notification about the completion of the corresponding operation. 583 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 This is done using the generic RTEEvent mechanism: the notification about an asynchronously executed operation having completed is implemented as an Asyn- chronousServerCallReturnsEvent . Therefore, if an AsynchronousServerCallReturnsEvent is raised the RTE can either trigger the execution of a specific RunnableEntity or the AtomicSwCom- ponentType can implement a WaitPoint that blocks the execution of the calling RunnableEntity until the AsynchronousServerCallReturnsEvent is recog- nized.
